# BlitzBasic: Strings

Searching, slicing, converting and formatting text.


Back to [[BlitzBasic]] or the [[Command-Index]].

| Command | Returns | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Asc](BlitzBasic-Strings#asc) | Int | Returns the character code of the first character of a string. |
| [Bin](BlitzBasic-Strings#bin) | String | Turns a number into its binary digits. |
| [Chr](BlitzBasic-Strings#chr) | String | Returns the one-character string for a character code. |
| [CurrentDate](BlitzBasic-Strings#currentdate) | String | Returns today's date from the system clock as day, abbreviated month and year, for example `26 Oct 2026`. |
| [CurrentTime](BlitzBasic-Strings#currenttime) | String | Returns the time of day from the system clock as `HH:MM:SS` on a 24 hour clock. |
| [Hex](BlitzBasic-Strings#hex) | String | Turns a number into hexadecimal digits. |
| [Instr](BlitzBasic-Strings#instr) | Int | Finds the first position of a piece of text inside another string. |
| [Left](BlitzBasic-Strings#left) | String | Returns the first characters of a string. |
| [Len](BlitzBasic-Strings#len) | Int |  |
| [Lower](BlitzBasic-Strings#lower) | String | Returns a copy of the string with every letter in lower case. |
| [LSet](BlitzBasic-Strings#lset) | String | Makes a string exactly `size` characters long by cutting it off or padding it with spaces on the right, so the text stays on the left. |
| [Mid](BlitzBasic-Strings#mid) | String | Returns a piece from the middle of a string. |
| [Replace](BlitzBasic-Strings#replace) | String | Replaces every occurrence of a piece of text with another. |
| [Right](BlitzBasic-Strings#right) | String | Returns the last characters of a string. |
| [RSet](BlitzBasic-Strings#rset) | String | Makes a string exactly `size` characters long by padding it with spaces on the left, or cutting off its start, so the text stays on the right. |
| [String](BlitzBasic-Strings#string) | String | Repeats a string several times. |
| [Trim](BlitzBasic-Strings#trim) | String | Removes spaces, tabs and other invisible characters from both ends of a string. |
| [Upper](BlitzBasic-Strings#upper) | String | Returns a copy of the string with every letter in upper case. |

### Asc

```blitzbasic
Asc string$  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns the character code of the first character of a string. It is the opposite of [Chr](BlitzBasic-Strings#chr).

```blitzbasic
Print Asc("A")
Print Asc("BCD")
```

```text
65
66
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. Only its first character counts. |

**Returns:** A code from 0 to 255.

### Bin

```blitzbasic
Bin value%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Turns a number into its binary digits. The result always has 32 digits, so negative numbers show their two's complement form.

```blitzbasic
Print Bin$(5)
```

```text
00000000000000000000000000000101
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Int | required | The number to convert. |

**Returns:** A string of 32 digits, 0 and 1.

### Chr

```blitzbasic
Chr ascii%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns the one-character string for a character code. [Asc](BlitzBasic-Strings#asc) does the opposite.

```blitzbasic
Print Chr$(72) + Chr$(105)
```

```text
Hi
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ascii` | Int | required | The character code, 0 to 255. |

**Returns:** A string with a single character.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Strings end at the first zero byte, so `Chr$(0)` is the same as an empty string.

### CurrentDate

```blitzbasic
CurrentDate  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns today's date from the system clock as day, abbreviated month and year, for example `26 Oct 2026`.

```blitzbasic
Print "Today is " + CurrentDate$()
```

**Returns:** The date as text.

### CurrentTime

```blitzbasic
CurrentTime  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns the time of day from the system clock as `HH:MM:SS` on a 24 hour clock.

```blitzbasic
Print "It is " + CurrentTime$()
```

**Returns:** The time as text.

### Hex

```blitzbasic
Hex value%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Turns a number into hexadecimal digits. The result always has 8 digits, so negative numbers show their two's complement form.

```blitzbasic
Print Hex$(255)
Print Hex$(-1)
```

```text
000000FF
FFFFFFFF
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Int | required | The number to convert. |

**Returns:** A string of 8 digits, 0 to 9 and A to F.

### Instr

```blitzbasic
Instr string$, find$, from%=1  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Finds the first position of a piece of text inside another string. Positions start at 1, and 0 means it was not found. The search tells upper and lower case apart.

```blitzbasic
Print Instr("hello world", "o")
Print Instr("hello world", "o", 6)
Print Instr("hello", "z")
```

```text
5
8
0
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text to search in. |
| `find` | String | required | The text to look for. |
| `from` | Int | `1` | Position to start searching at. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** The position of the first match, or 0.

### Left

```blitzbasic
Left string$, count%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns the first characters of a string. Asking for more characters than there are returns the whole string.

```blitzbasic
Print Left$("hello", 2)
Print Left$("hello", 10)
```

```text
he
hello
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |
| `count` | Int | required | How many characters to take. |

**Returns:** The first `count` characters.

### Len

```blitzbasic
Len string$  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

```blitzbasic
Print Len("hello")
```

```text
5
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text to measure. |

**Returns:** How many characters a string has. An empty string has 0.

### Lower

```blitzbasic
Lower string$  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns a copy of the string with every letter in lower case.

```blitzbasic
Print Lower$("Hello World 1!")
```

```text
hello world 1!
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The lower case text.

### LSet

```blitzbasic
LSet string$, size%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Makes a string exactly `size` characters long by cutting it off or padding it with spaces on the right, so the text stays on the left. Useful for columns.

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + LSet$("ab", 5) + "]"
Print "[" + LSet$("abcdef", 3) + "]"
```

```text
[ab   ]
[abc]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |
| `size` | Int | required | The length of the result. |

**Returns:** A string of exactly `size` characters.

### Mid

```blitzbasic
Mid string$, start%, count%=-1  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns a piece from the middle of a string. The first character is number 1. Without a count it takes everything to the end, and a count that is too long is cut off at the end.

```blitzbasic
Print Mid$("hello", 2, 3)
Print Mid$("hello", 3)
```

```text
ell
llo
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |
| `start` | Int | required | Position of the first character to take. |
| `count` | Int | `-1` | How many characters to take. Defaults to all that are left. |

**Returns:** The piece of the string.

### Replace

```blitzbasic
Replace string$, from$, to$  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Replaces every occurrence of a piece of text with another. What was put in is not searched again, so replacing `a` with `aa` does not loop.

```blitzbasic
Print Replace$("a-b-c", "-", "+")
Print Replace$("a-b-c", "-", "")
```

```text
a+b+c
abc
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text to change. |
| `from` | String | required | What to look for. |
| `to` | String | required | What to put in its place. May be empty to remove it. |

**Returns:** The changed text.

### Right

```blitzbasic
Right string$, count%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns the last characters of a string. Asking for more characters than there are returns the whole string.

```blitzbasic
Print Right$("hello", 2)
```

```text
lo
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |
| `count` | Int | required | How many characters to take. |

**Returns:** The last `count` characters.

### RSet

```blitzbasic
RSet string$, size%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Makes a string exactly `size` characters long by padding it with spaces on the left, or cutting off its start, so the text stays on the right. Useful for numbers in columns.

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + RSet$("42", 5) + "]"
Print "[" + RSet$("abcdef", 3) + "]"
```

```text
[   42]
[def]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |
| `size` | Int | required | The length of the result. |

**Returns:** A string of exactly `size` characters.

### String

```blitzbasic
String string$, repeat%  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Repeats a string several times.

```blitzbasic
Print String$("ab", 3)
```

```text
ababab
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text to repeat. |
| `repeat` | Int | required | How many copies to join. 0 gives an empty string. |

**Returns:** The repeated text.

### Trim

```blitzbasic
Trim string$  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Removes spaces, tabs and other invisible characters from both ends of a string.

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + Trim$("   hi there  ") + "]"
```

```text
[hi there]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The text without the blanks at its ends.

### Upper

```blitzbasic
Upper string$  ; returns String
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns a copy of the string with every letter in upper case.

```blitzbasic
Print Upper$("Hello World 1!")
```

```text
HELLO WORLD 1!
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The upper case text.
